description: This Java class 'OpenAPIParser' provides utility methods for parsing OpenAPI specifications, caching parsed results, and ensuring each operation has an ID. It handles loading OpenAPI specs from URLs or content, and maps HTTP methods to operations.

classes.name: OpenAPIParser
classes.description: Utility class for parsing and handling OpenAPI specifications, including caching and operation ID management.

methods.name: isSpecUrl
methods.description: Checks if the given string is a URL referencing an API spec file with specific suffixes (.json, .yaml, .yml).

methods.name: buildOpenAPI
methods.description: Loads and parses an OpenAPI specification from a URL or content, with caching and error handling.

methods.name: addMissingOperationIds
methods.description: Ensures all operations in the OpenAPI paths have an operationId, assigning default IDs where missing.

methods.name: mapOperations
methods.description: Maps HTTP methods to their corresponding Operation objects within a PathItem.
